statements.__comment: Reset exposed_internet properties on all OCI instances in scope
statements.query: MATCH (n:OCIInstance)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:OCICompartment{id: $OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE n.exposed_internet IS NOT NULL WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE REMOVE n.exposed_internet, n.exposed_internet_type, n.publicContext RETURN COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

statements.__comment: Mark instances as exposed if a VNIC has a public IP and one of its subnet's OWN security lists admits non-ICMP ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 (allows_internet_ingress, set at ingest). Security lists synced before that flag existed fall back to the raw rule text.
statements.query: MATCH (inst:OCIInstance)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:OCICompartment{id: $OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) MATCH (inst)-[:OCI_VNIC_ATTACHMENT]->(:OCIVnicAttachment)-[:OCI_VNIC]->(vnic:OCIVnic) WHERE vnic.public_ip IS NOT NULL AND vnic.public_ip <> '' MATCH (subnet:OCISubnet{id: vnic.subnet_id}) MATCH (sl:OCISecurityList) WHERE sl.id IN coalesce(subnet.security_list_ids, []) AND coalesce(sl.allows_internet_ingress, sl.ingress_security_rules CONTAINS '0.0.0.0/0' OR sl.ingress_security_rules CONTAINS '::/0') WITH DISTINCT inst SET inst.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT 'unrestricted_securitylist_ingress' IN coalesce(inst.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN inst END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(inst.exposed_internet_type, []) + 'unrestricted_securitylist_ingress'

statements.__comment: Mark instances as exposed if a VNIC has a public IP and one of the NSGs attached to THAT VNIC has a rule admitting non-ICMP ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 (is_internet_ingress, set at ingest). Rules synced before that flag existed fall back to direction + source.
statements.query: MATCH (inst:OCIInstance)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:OCICompartment{id: $OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) MATCH (inst)-[:OCI_VNIC_ATTACHMENT]->(:OCIVnicAttachment)-[:OCI_VNIC]->(vnic:OCIVnic) WHERE vnic.public_ip IS NOT NULL AND vnic.public_ip <> '' MATCH (nsg:OCINetworkSecurityGroup)-[:OCI_NSG_RULE]->(rule:OCINsgSecurityRule) WHERE nsg.id IN coalesce(vnic.nsg_ids, []) AND coalesce(rule.is_internet_ingress, rule.direction = 'INGRESS' AND rule.source IN ['0.0.0.0/0', '::/0']) WITH DISTINCT inst SET inst.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT 'unrestricted_nsg_ingress' IN coalesce(inst.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN inst END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(inst.exposed_internet_type, []) + 'unrestricted_nsg_ingress'

statements.__comment: Fail-safe: a VNIC with a public IP whose subnet, subnet security lists or NSGs are not in the graph (other compartment, not synced) cannot be proven closed, so the instance stays exposed as before
statements.query: MATCH (inst:OCIInstance)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:OCICompartment{id: $OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) MATCH (inst)-[:OCI_VNIC_ATTACHMENT]->(:OCIVnicAttachment)-[:OCI_VNIC]->(vnic:OCIVnic) WHERE vnic.public_ip IS NOT NULL AND vnic.public_ip <> '' OPTIONAL MATCH (subnet:OCISubnet{id: vnic.subnet_id}) OPTIONAL MATCH (sl:OCISecurityList) WHERE sl.id IN coalesce(subnet.security_list_ids, []) WITH inst, vnic, subnet, count(DISTINCT sl) AS known_security_lists OPTIONAL MATCH (nsg:OCINetworkSecurityGroup) WHERE nsg.id IN coalesce(vnic.nsg_ids, []) WITH inst, vnic, subnet, known_security_lists, count(DISTINCT nsg) AS known_nsgs WHERE subnet IS NULL OR known_security_lists < size(coalesce(subnet.security_list_ids, [])) OR known_nsgs < size(coalesce(vnic.nsg_ids, [])) WITH DISTINCT inst SET inst.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT 'public_ip_unresolved_rules' IN coalesce(inst.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN inst END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(inst.exposed_internet_type, []) + 'public_ip_unresolved_rules'

statements.__comment: Build publicContext JSON for exposed instances from their public VNICs and the open rules that apply to them
statements.query: MATCH (inst:OCIInstance)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:OCICompartment{id: $OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE inst.exposed_internet = true MATCH (inst)-[:OCI_VNIC_ATTACHMENT]->(:OCIVnicAttachment)-[:OCI_VNIC]->(vnic:OCIVnic) WHERE vnic.public_ip IS NOT NULL AND vnic.public_ip <> '' OPTIONAL MATCH (subnet:OCISubnet{id: vnic.subnet_id}) OPTIONAL MATCH (sl:OCISecurityList) WHERE sl.id IN coalesce(subnet.security_list_ids, []) AND coalesce(sl.allows_internet_ingress, sl.ingress_security_rules CONTAINS '0.0.0.0/0' OR sl.ingress_security_rules CONTAINS '::/0') WITH inst, vnic, subnet, collect(DISTINCT sl.id) AS openSecurityListIds OPTIONAL MATCH (nsg:OCINetworkSecurityGroup)-[:OCI_NSG_RULE]->(rule:OCINsgSecurityRule) WHERE nsg.id IN coalesce(vnic.nsg_ids, []) AND coalesce(rule.is_internet_ingress, rule.direction = 'INGRESS' AND rule.source IN ['0.0.0.0/0', '::/0']) WITH inst, vnic, subnet, openSecurityListIds, [r IN collect(DISTINCT {nsgId: nsg.id, ruleId: rule.id, protocol: rule.protocol, source: rule.source, tcpPortMin: rule.tcp_dest_port_min, tcpPortMax: rule.tcp_dest_port_max}) WHERE r.ruleId IS NOT NULL] AS nsgRules ORDER BY vnic.is_primary DESC WITH inst, collect({vnicId: vnic.id, publicIp: vnic.public_ip, privateIp: vnic.private_ip, subnetId: vnic.subnet_id, vcnId: subnet.vcn_id, prohibitPublicIp: subnet.prohibit_public_ip_on_vnic, openSecurityListIds: openSecurityListIds, nsgRules: nsgRules}) AS vnics SET inst.publicContext = apoc.convert.toJson([{resource: inst.ocid, resourceType: 'oci-compute-vm-instance', context: [{instanceId: inst.ocid, instanceName: inst.display_name, publicIp: vnics[0].publicIp, privateIp: vnics[0].privateIp, shape: inst.shape, region: inst.region, subnetId: vnics[0].subnetId, vcnId: vnics[0].vcnId, prohibitPublicIp: vnics[0].prohibitPublicIp, exposureTypes: inst.exposed_internet_type, openSecurityListIds: reduce(ids = [], v IN vnics | ids + v.openSecurityListIds), nsgRules: reduce(rules = [], v IN vnics | rules + v.nsgRules), vnics: vnics}]}])
